# Welcoming Everett Hu to Infinite


By[Nikhil Srinivasan](https://infinite.net/company/about) , Founder & CEO


·


March 16, 2026


·


1 min read


Everett Hu has joined Infinite as our Founding Member of Technical Staff, helping to shape and lead our product engineering.


He’s built products from the ground up at high-growth fintechs like NerdWallet, then led product engineering and product strategy at companies like dYdX. That combination of frontline financial services experience and product thinking aligns perfectly with what we are building here at Infinite.


Welcome to the team, Everett.
